body.x: The Consumer Technology Association (CTA) has scheduled a major thought leadership event for CES 2026: a live, unscripted taping of the influential “All-In” podcast that will dissect the ongoing Artificial Intelligence (AI) revolution. The keynote will feature podcast co-host Jason Calacanis in conversation with two of the world’s most prominent business minds, Bob Sternfels, Global Managing Partner at McKinsey & Company, and Hemant Taneja, CEO of General Catalyst.

The event, set for 2 PM PST on Tuesday, January 6, in the Palazzo Ballroom at the Venetian, promises to explore how AI is fundamentally redefining global corporate strategy, investment priorities, and the future of innovation.

Kinsey Fabrizio, President of CTA, described the significance of the convergence of these voices: “This is CES at its best — a convergence of ideas, influence, and innovation. AI isn’t just reshaping industries, it’s rewriting the rules of leadership, strategy, and opportunity. CES is where innovators show up and lead the AI revolution.”

body.cap: Hemant Taneja, CEO of General Catalyst | Photo by CTA

body.x: The discussion will bring together different perspectives on where the smart money is moving within the AI sector, analyzing which technologies are currently overvalued and which are poised for explosive growth. Sternfels, whose firm McKinsey & Company has integrated its own generative AI platform, Lilli, into its operations, noted that the conversation will explore the technology’s potential to transform enterprises and guide leaders on building AI-driven value.

Taneja, who leads General Catalyst, a venture and transformation company with over $40 billion under management, views tech not just as a disruptive force, but as a “catalyst for complete industry transformation.” He suggested the keynote will unite strategic vision and investment power to help groundbreaking ideas mature into lasting enterprises. Calacanis, a well-known early-stage investor with a track record of spotting companies like Uber and Robinhood, is excited to bring the podcast’s signature “no-BS, full-contact” debate style to the CES keynote stage.

body.cap: Jason Calcanis, Entrepreneur, Angel Investor, and Co-Host of the All-In podcast | Photo by CTA

body.x: Further underscoring the shift from purely digital to physical applications of AI, CES 2026 will host the session “Transforming Industries with Physical AI,” presented by McKinsey. This specialized conference session will explore the real-world adoption of Physical AI, which refers to AI that enables machines to perceive, understand, and interact directly with the physical world using sensors and actuators—effectively serving as the “brain” for autonomous vehicles, robots, and innovative industrial systems.

This session will investigate how these advancements are reshaping industries, work, and the future of automation, moving beyond virtual capabilities to tangible physical impact. Speakers for this deep dive include Alex Panas, Senior Partner and Global Leader of Industry Sectors at McKinsey, and Ani Kelkar, a Consultant with the firm.

The All-In interview is part of a high-profile series of keynotes at CES 2026, which also features leaders such as Dr. Lisa Su of AMD, Joe Creed of Caterpillar, Yannick Bolloré of Havas and Vivendi, and Yuanqing Yang of Lenovo.
